find.caption: Space f, then sched.h, in a tree with the Linux kernel's 97,362 file paths. The fixture has the kernel's paths, not its sources: each file is a two-line stub, which is what the preview shows.
find.alt: The strop file finder over 97,362 files with sched.h typed: a list of matching file names with their directories on the left, a preview of the selected file on the right.

replace.caption: Space R in a small Rust project: total_cents to sum_cents. Every hit is listed under its file as a - row and a + row while you type; nothing has changed on disk yet.
replace.alt: strop's search with a Find field reading total_cents and a With field reading sum_cents; below, each hit grouped by file as a removed line and an added line, and a preview of the first file on the right.

git.caption: <kbd>]c</kbd> to the next changed hunk, then <kbd>Space</kbd> <kbd>g</kbd> <kbd>p</kbd>: the hunk under the cursor as a diff, in an ordinary read-only buffer.
git.alt: strop showing one git hunk as a diff: old and new line numbers in two columns, the removed and added lines marked in the gutter.
